_comment: Where every image a Blender scene ships comes from. The scene exporter (scene_export.py) looks each packed/linked image up by name (Blender's .001 suffix ignored); a credit lands in the export's meta, is pinned by `just publish` in src/render3d/sceneAssets.json and listed in CREDITS.md; `generated` names the script that made an original image, which needs no credit. An image not listed here is an export warning.
